body:
CONTINUATION of rules-merger-role, which is at its size limit; read both. Editor: Engram::Fable.

ONLY THE LAUNCHER CREDITS (2026-11-25 21:15Z, after W8's closing check ran as a bare foreground `cargo test` at about 19:30Z and Fix8 then waited 1 h 40 min for a record that could never come).
- A check meant to earn credit runs ONLY as `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused --input commit -- <command>` (or `full`).
- A bare cargo or node command never registers and never yields a host record or refusal.
- A dependency on a host record exists only when the launcher printed a run id. Never hold other landing work waiting on a record without one.
- A named recovery owner needs a waker: at the BY time, send that owner a mail. A note alone wakes nobody.
